text:
Alex: Okay team, real questionwhat's the strangest thing you've ever found in the office fridge or kitchen? Pictures optional but preferred. :eyes:
Sami: A single, perfectly intact birthday candle stuck to a jar of pesto. No cake in sight. :birthday:
Jo: Once found a sandwich labeled "for Greg" dated 2019. Hypotheses about time travel were discussed. :thinking_face:
Priya: A hard-boiled egg wrapped in tin foil inside a Tupperware that said "DO NOT EAT" in permanent marker. Obviously we respected it. Mostly.
Alex: "DO NOT EAT" is the greatest kitchen poetry. Any wild science experiments?
Sami: Someone had a "sourdough starter" jar with a sticky note "do not throw out" and a day-by-day chart like it was a plant. It had a tiny flag.
Jo: Found a mason jar with three pairs of mismatched socks in it once. No context.
Priya: There was a bowl labeled "office conspiracy snacks" that contained one lonely chocolate chip. We considered a sting operation.
Alex: @kitchen-bot can we set a lost-and-found shelf for the socks and the existential chocolate?
kitchen-bot: Added sticky note: "Lost & Found Shelf (near microwave)". Reminder weekly. :package:
Sami: My favorite: an avocado with googly eyes taped on it and a post-it that read "Gary the Avocado: do not disturb". Gary is now a legend.
Jo: Also found a frozen pineapple with a tiny note "icebreaker prop". We used it in last holiday party for... reasons.
Priya: Bonus question: what's the weirdest labeling you've seen?
Alex: Someone labeled a container "definitely not kimchi". That was both honest and suspicious.
Sami: Label "For testing only - do not open" turned out to be a jar of leftover dill pickles. The office is full of false promises.
Jo: We should make a "Kitchen Hall of Fame" for the strangest finds. Photos encouraged.
Priya: I'll start a thread album. Upload your discoveries with captions and a rating out of 10 for mystery.
Alex: Vote with emoji: :fridge: if you support a physical lost-and-found shelf, :camera_with_flash: for the photo album, :shrug: for both.
Sami: :fridge:
Jo: :camera_with_flash:
Priya: :fridge:
Alex: Looks like both is happening. Thanks for the laughs  I will check the microwave for Gary. :sparkles:
